summary: Agent of Empires (aoe) is a Rust session manager for AI coding agents, not an agent itself: it normally wraps third-party CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, ...) in tmux or ACP workers. Its only self-contained model client is the bundled `aoe-agent` ACP worker (acp-worker/aoe-agent/src/index.ts, Node 22.6+, Vercel AI SDK 7) which drives an Anthropic/OpenAI/Google model with Read/Write/Bash tools that aoe executes in the session's working directory. Headless flow: `aoe serve --daemon --no-auth` starts the daemon, `aoe add <dir> --agent aoe-agent --model <m>` creates a structured-view session whose worker the daemon reconciler auto-spawns (resolving `aoe-agent` from PATH), `aoe acp prompt <id> <text>` sends the task, and `aoe acp history <id> --json` exposes the event log where a `{"Stopped":{"reason":"end_turn"}}` event marks turn completion. Model calls: `@ai-sdk/anthropic` reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (it appends `/messages`, so the base must be `$PROXY_URL/v1`); aoe only forwards ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the worker by allowlist, so the run command writes a config.toml whose top-level `environment` list passes ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL through to the worker process. The model id (`claude-*` prefix picks the Anthropic provider) reaches the worker as AOE_AGENT_MODEL via `--model`.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=debian:bookworm-slim
FROM ${BASE}

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
# tmux/procps: aoe runtime. build-essential/pkg-config/perl/cmake/zlib: cargo build (git2 vendors openssl+libgit2).
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      ca-certificates curl git tmux procps \
      build-essential pkg-config perl cmake zlib1g-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Self-contained Node runtime for the bundled aoe-agent ACP worker (needs >= 22.6 for --experimental-strip-types).
ARG NODE_VERSION=22.21.0
RUN set -eux; \
    case "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" in \
      amd64) narch=x64 ;; \
      arm64) narch=arm64 ;; \
      *) echo "unsupported architecture" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/node /opt/harness/bin; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${narch}.tar.gz" \
      | tar -xz -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH

# Harness source (build context = repo root).
COPY . /opt/harness/src

# Build the `aoe` binary (daemon + ACP client are in the default feature set; no Node/web needed)
# with a Rust toolchain kept under /opt/harness, then drop the toolchain and target dir.
ENV RUSTUP_HOME=/opt/harness/rustup CARGO_HOME=/opt/harness/cargo
RUN set -eux; \
    curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable --no-modify-path; \
    cd /opt/harness/src; \
    /opt/harness/cargo/bin/cargo build --profile dev-release --bin aoe; \
    cp target/dev-release/aoe /opt/harness/bin/aoe; \
    rm -rf target /opt/harness/rustup /opt/harness/cargo

# aoe-agent: the bundled multi-provider ACP worker (Vercel AI SDK). Installed from the copied
# sources into its own prefix; the wrapper on PATH is what aoe's agent registry resolves for `aoe-agent`.
RUN set -eux; \
    cp -r /opt/harness/src/acp-worker/aoe-agent /opt/harness/aoe-agent; \
    cd /opt/harness/aoe-agent; \
    npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; \
    printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /opt/harness/node/bin/node --experimental-strip-types /opt/harness/aoe-agent/src/index.ts "$@"\n' > /opt/harness/bin/aoe-agent; \
    chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/aoe-agent
run_command:
set -u
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL:-$PROXY_URL/v1}"
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-proxy}"
MODEL="${AOE_AGENT_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-4-5}"
PORT="${AOE_PORT:-8089}"
AOE_DIR="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/agent-of-empires"
mkdir -p "$AOE_DIR" /out
CFG="$AOE_DIR/config.toml"
# Forward the proxy base URL to the worker (aoe's allowlist only forwards the API key), and silence update checks / auto-rename.
if [ ! -f "$CFG" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'environment = ["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"]' '' '[session]' 'smart_rename = false' '' '[updates]' 'update_check_mode = "off"' > "$CFG"
fi
aoe serve --daemon --no-auth --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" </dev/null || exit 1
ADD_OUT="$(aoe add "$PWD" -t "aoe-task-$(date +%s)" --agent aoe-agent --model "$MODEL" </dev/null)" || { printf '%s\n' "$ADD_OUT"; aoe serve --stop; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$ADD_OUT"
SID="$(printf '%s\n' "$ADD_OUT" | sed -n 's/^ *ID: *//p' | head -n1)"
[ -n "$SID" ] || { echo "could not parse session id" >&2; aoe serve --stop; exit 1; }
PROMPT="Working directory: $PWD. Read and edit files there using absolute paths. The Bash tool takes a program plus an args array (for a shell pipeline use command \"sh\" with args [\"-c\", \"...\"]).

$TASK"
deadline=$((SECONDS+240))
until aoe acp prompt "$SID" "$PROMPT" </dev/null; do
  if [ "$SECONDS" -ge "$deadline" ]; then echo "worker never accepted the prompt" >&2; aoe acp logs --session "$SID" || true; aoe serve --stop || true; exit 1; fi
  sleep 1
done
deadline=$((SECONDS+${AOE_TASK_TIMEOUT:-3600}))
status=0
while :; do
  if aoe acp history "$SID" --json 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '"(Stopped|PromptRuntimeError|AgentStartupError|IncompatibleAgent|PromptRejected)"'; then break; fi
  if [ "$SECONDS" -ge "$deadline" ]; then echo "timed out waiting for the turn to finish" >&2; aoe acp cancel "$SID" || true; status=124; break; fi
  sleep 2
done
aoe acp history "$SID" --json > /out/aoe-history.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true
aoe acp logs --session "$SID" > /out/aoe-worker.log 2>&1 || true
cp -r "$AOE_DIR/artifacts/$SID" /out/aoe-artifacts 2>/dev/null || true
cp "$AOE_DIR"/*.log /out/ 2>/dev/null || true
node -e 'const fs=require("fs");let out="";for(const l of fs.readFileSync("/out/aoe-history.jsonl","utf8").split("\n")){if(!l)continue;try{const e=JSON.parse(l).event;if(e&&e.AgentMessageChunk&&typeof e.AgentMessageChunk.text==="string")out+=e.AgentMessageChunk.text}catch{}}process.stdout.write(out+"\n")' 2>/dev/null || true
aoe acp stop --all </dev/null || true
aoe serve --stop </dev/null || true
exit $status
check_command: aoe --help >/dev/null && aoe acp agents && node --version && timeout 30 aoe-agent </dev/null
notes:
Key facts and caveats:
- aoe is a session manager; the only in-repo model client is acp-worker/aoe-agent (Vercel AI SDK 7). All other "agents" it manages are external CLIs that are not installed here. The recipe therefore runs the task through aoe's own headless structured-view path: `aoe serve --daemon --no-auth` -> `aoe add --agent aoe-agent --model` -> `aoe acp prompt` -> poll `aoe acp history --json` for a `Stopped` event -> `aoe acp stop --all` / `aoe serve --stop`.
- Proxy wiring: @ai-sdk/anthropic 4.0.53 reads ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and appends `/messages`, so the base must be `$PROXY_URL/v1`. @ai-sdk/openai 4.0.66 reads OPENAI_BASE_URL but its default `openai(model)` factory is the Responses API, so the Anthropic path is used. aoe forwards only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL/GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY to aoe-agent by allowlist; the run command writes `<app_dir>/config.toml` with a top-level `environment = ["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"]` passthrough (documented feature) so the worker sees the base URL. Model ids starting with `claude-` (or `anthropic:`) select the Anthropic provider; `--model` is delivered to the worker as AOE_AGENT_MODEL.
- aoe-agent has no system prompt and never tells the model its cwd; its Bash tool runs `Command::new(command).args(args)` without a shell. The run command prepends one line to $TASK stating the working directory and the Bash tool's program+args shape. aoe's fs handler restricts reads/writes to the session's project dir (the task cwd), so absolute paths under cwd are required.
- aoe-agent never issues ACP permission requests (tools run through aoe's fs/terminal handlers), so no approvals can block a headless run. Each turn is capped at 16 tool-call steps by aoe-agent (stepCountIs(16)).
- Completion detection: history events are externally tagged serde JSON, e.g. {"session_id":..,"seq":..,"event":{"Stopped":{"reason":"end_turn"}}}. `aoe acp prompt` returns once accepted, not when finished, and fails while the worker is still spawning/handshaking (daemon reconciler ticks every 2s), hence the retry loop.
- Outputs under /out: aoe-history.jsonl (full event log incl. AgentMessageChunk/ToolCallStarted/ToolCallCompleted), aoe-worker.log (runner + adapter stderr via `aoe acp logs`), aoe-artifacts/ (aoe-agent's persisted transcript written to AOE_ARTIFACT_DIR), daemon log. The final assistant text is also printed to stdout.
- State lives in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME or $HOME/.config/agent-of-empires (release namespace; dev-release profile is used so the binary shares the release namespace and port defaults). DO_NOT_TRACK=1 suppresses opt-in telemetry entirely; update checks are disabled in config. tmux is not used by structured sessions but is installed since aoe expects it.
- Build: `cargo build --profile dev-release --bin aoe` (release opts without LTO, no web feature so no npm at build). Needs build-essential, perl, cmake, pkg-config, zlib1g-dev because git2 vendors OpenSSL/libgit2. The toolchain and target dir are removed after the build. Node 22.21.0 (the version aoe itself pins) is unpacked under /opt/harness/node; the aoe-agent wrapper on PATH matches what `aoe acp doctor --fix --adapter aoe-agent` would generate, so nothing is run or modified in the harness at build time.
- Port: AOE_PORT (default 8089 here) must be free in the task container; change it if the task image binds it.
